validation: Sentiment checked blind by a second model (Sonnet) on a sample of 221 of the 958 stories (every low-confidence row plus 100 at random), with Claude Fable 5.2 ruling on every disagreement: the check agreed with the coding on 176 (80%, and 93 of the 100 random rows); after review 24 labels were changed, and 8 more copies of the same events were aligned with those rulings.
sources: The monitoring deck's 363 clippings (slides 18 to 358), plus 609 stories the deck missed from every page of Dainik Savera (including its district pages), The Savera Times (including its district editions) and the District Front Page file (Punjabi Tribune, Rozana Spokesman, Punjabi Jagran and Dainik Jagran district pages). The other papers' main editions are covered by the deck only; all 14 papers arrived. Relevant = about AAP, the Punjab government or a state matter.
takeaway: {negative_share} of the {relevant} relevant stories were negative and {positive_share} positive. The killing of head constable Vinod Kumar in Gurdaspur was the biggest story, in 14 papers with 13 front pages, and 22 of its 31 rows were negative despite the CM's Rs 2 crore help to the family. The CM's appeal to reopen the Kartarpur corridor (14 papers, 10 front pages, all positive) and police action (141 stories) carried the good news.
